Document: Meridian pilot notes, Thu 29 Oct 2026
Section: Meridian pilot notes: Thursday 29 October 2026

Written by: Karan Malhotra

First weekly status call held at 4 PM. Neha's team sent the invite, so the open question from Tuesday is closed.Meera found a column in Meridian's sample file that is not in the specification: remitter VPA. Meridian confirmed it is optional. Decision: the field is mapped as optional and will not block ingestion.Meridian legal signed the NDA late in the evening.Riya started preparing the SOC 2 report package for Vikram Rao. Under our process the report goes out within 3 business days of a signed NDA.Questionnaire work: the team is answering from the policy documents and will send it by the due date, Fri 6 Nov.
